integrity: Explicit 14-source code, rational output cover and rational fractional packing are accompanied by a standalone exact integer checker; the upper bound is an exhaustive combinatorial branch search with proven greedy-color pruning and 452972 verified nodes.
scientific_limitations: Finite results only for partitions of at most six elements; the exact six-point fractional optimum and larger sizes are not determined. External unindexed earlier coverage remains possible. Independent audit is not performed.
title: A first integer-rounding gap in deletion codes on set partitions
